title: Pass the work on
task: Help a small team hand over unfinished work without a long activity log.
notice: Exploratory ideas, not built prototypes or cultural studies. Human review unrecorded.

synthesis.title: Prediction Baton: three-slot handover checked by the receiver's guess
synthesis.action: Sender fills stuck, next, ask-me slots by keyboard or drag; overflow forces prioritizing.
synthesis.feedback: After a cooling window, receiver's predicted next step appears; sender corrects mismatches inline, undoably.
synthesis.mechanism: Immediate capture, delayed reread, then receiver confirms, flags, or rejects each slot, reopening the draft.
synthesis.difference: Handover is validated by prediction mismatch between sender and receiver, not by logging activity.
synthesis.risks: Cooling delay may annoy; predictions may bias framing; timeouts need clear reopen and reject paths.
synthesis.feasibility: Local web page with fictional tasks, localStorage, ARIA live announcements, and a state machine.
synthesis.prototype: Proposed offline demo; planned test compares resume accuracy from batons versus fictional logs, not yet run.

proposals.title: Baton Knot: tie off unfinished work in three pulls
proposals.action: Owner drags task onto baton, records three quick pull-cards.
proposals.feedback: Baton tightens visibly; loose strands flag missing next step or blocker.
proposals.mechanism: Immediate pulls capture state; receiver later unties, correcting each strand.
proposals.difference: Handover is a negotiated knot, not a log or form.
proposals.risks: Oversimplified strands may hide nuance; receivers may skip untying.
proposals.feasibility: Local web app with fictional tasks and drag interactions.
proposals.prototype: Clickable offline mockup; usability sessions proposed, not yet conducted.

proposals.title: Baton Card with Cooling Draft
proposals.action: Leaver drags open tasks onto a baton card, then states next step.
proposals.feedback: Card shows draft state, then sealed after ten-minute reflection window.
proposals.mechanism: Immediate capture locks into a delayed, editable seal before receiver accepts.
proposals.difference: Handover is a timed state machine, not a log or note.
proposals.risks: Leavers may skip reflection; receiver may distrust unsealed drafts.
proposals.feasibility: Local React state machine with fictional tasks and localStorage persistence.
proposals.prototype: Single-page offline demo: draft, cooling, sealed, accepted, reopened states.

proposals.title: Two-Pass Handover Postcard
proposals.action: Owner drags three task fragments onto a postcard before leaving.
proposals.feedback: Recipient's predicted next step appears; owner corrects it inline.
proposals.mechanism: Quick capture now, forced reread after ten minutes before sending.
proposals.difference: Delayed self-review replaces logs with one corrected, prediction-checked card.
proposals.risks: Delay may annoy; predictions could bias owners toward wrong framing.
proposals.feasibility: Local HTML prototype with fictional tasks and timer, no network.
proposals.prototype: Test whether recipients resume correctly from cards versus fictional logs.

proposals.title: Relay Baton: three-question handover passed by keyboard
proposals.action: Sender answers stuck, next, and ask-me prompts, then passes baton.
proposals.feedback: Receiver hears each answer read back and confirms or flags it.
proposals.mechanism: Baton holds exactly three slots; overflow forces sender to prioritize.
proposals.difference: Replaces activity logs with a constrained, confirmable verbal-style relay.
proposals.risks: Oversimplification may drop context; flagged slots need clear error recovery.
proposals.feasibility: Local web page with fictional tasks, localStorage, ARIA live regions.
proposals.prototype: Keyboard-only baton form with screen-reader readback and flag correction.

synthesis.title: Loose Ends Splice Board with Fast and Slow Rebinding
synthesis.action: Outgoing person ties each unfinished task to an open joint, marking blocker and next move.
synthesis.feedback: Joints glow frayed until rebound; quick-tied joints stay dashed, flagging pending deeper review.
synthesis.mechanism: Receiver chooses per joint: quick-tie to accept now, or slow-rebind by paraphrasing before acceptance.
synthesis.difference: Handover becomes mutual repair of few joints, explicitly trading immediacy against reflective understanding.
synthesis.risks: Quick-ties may become habitual; terse joints could hide context; paraphrase checks may feel burdensome.
synthesis.feasibility: Single offline web page using local storage, fictional tasks, no network or sensors.
synthesis.prototype: Proposed paper-then-HTML mock: four fictional tasks, tie, fray, quick-tie, paraphrase-rebind, untie undo.

proposals.title: Loose Ends Splice Board
proposals.action: Outgoing person ties each unfinished task to a named open joint.
proposals.feedback: Joints glow frayed until the receiver re-ties them in own words.
proposals.mechanism: Handover completes only when receiver rebinds every joint; untie reverses instantly.
proposals.difference: Replaces activity logs with a few loose joints needing mutual repair.
proposals.risks: Terse joints may hide context; receivers might rebind without understanding.
proposals.feasibility: Single offline web page with local storage and fictional tasks.
proposals.prototype: Paper-then-HTML mock: three fictional tasks, tie, fray, rebind, undo.

proposals.title: Reservoir Handover
proposals.action: Departing member pours unfinished tasks into a shared reservoir with uncertainty levels.
proposals.feedback: Water level shows remaining load; cloudy water marks uncertain task states.
proposals.mechanism: Receiver drains tasks through valves, confirming or correcting each before flow.
proposals.difference: Handover becomes a deliberate draining ritual, not reading logs.
proposals.risks: Metaphor may obscure urgency; cloudiness ratings may be inconsistent.
proposals.feasibility: Simple offline web app with local storage and fictional tasks.
proposals.prototype: Paper or browser mockup testing pour, cloud, drain, and correct steps.

proposals.title: Exit Stage Left: Handover Blocking Board
proposals.action: Departing member drags task tokens to marked stage positions.
proposals.feedback: Recipient sees spotlighted tokens, accepts, repositions, or questions each.
proposals.mechanism: Position encodes urgency; distance from center encodes reflection needed.
proposals.difference: Spatial staging replaces logs; handover becomes a choreographed entrance.
proposals.risks: Spatial meanings may confuse; positions could oversimplify nuanced work.
proposals.feasibility: Offline web canvas with fictional tasks and local storage.
proposals.prototype: Paper-and-browser mock: two roles, eight fictional tasks, undo.

proposals.title: Airlock Tags: handover as tagged repair parts
proposals.action: Departing member pins three physical-style tags onto one unfinished task.
proposals.feedback: Incoming member sees tags glow until each is confirmed or corrected.
proposals.mechanism: Tags force choices: blocker, next move, scarce resource at risk.
proposals.difference: Handover is a short tag ritual, not a scrolling log.
proposals.risks: Three tags may oversimplify; misread tags could waste scarce supplies.
proposals.feasibility: Offline web prototype with fictional habitat tasks and local storage.
proposals.prototype: Paper-and-browser mock; drag tags, rewrite, accept, untested so far.
